reason: It's a brand new name and I haven't seen one TikTok unboxing or heard a friend say they got their stuff. With my money I can't send 30,000 up front and wait three weeks hoping it shows up, when Shorja has kids' things I can hold in my hand today.
objection: I pay first and then wait 2 to 3 weeks for a shop nobody I know has used. If it gets lost or stuck, who do I chase? And 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 pair of shoes is almost as much as the shoes.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real unboxing videos from Baghdad moms on TikTok, or a friend getting her order on time with no extra charge at the door.
